description: Check a request submitted in this session. Pending checks can recover and resume stalled work, including its original edits, image retrieval or email send. Pass its original requestId. Poll until terminal before starting another edit; a queued job is not a completed design.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.

name: get_design_request
title: Check a design request
